title: Wayfare Pass Billing Standard — Declined Fee Retry and Grace Schedule
content:
# Declined fee retry and grace schedule — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

When a Wayfare Pass membership fee is declined, the plan's retry count, retry interval and grace period below apply.

| Plan | Retries of a declined fee before the membership ends | Days between retries (calendar days) | Grace after the first decline (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | 3 | 2 | 7 |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | 3 | 2 | 7 |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | 3 | 3 | 14 |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | 3 | 2 | 7 |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | 3 | 3 | 14 |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | 3 | 3 | 14 |

## Definitions

- **Retries**: the retries of a declined membership fee before the membership ends, as a count.
- **Days between retries**: the days between retries of a declined fee, in calendar days.
- **Grace**: the days after the first decline during which the membership stays past due before it ends, in calendar days.

## Points of reading

- Every plan retries a declined fee 3 times; the plans differ only in spacing and grace.
- The monthly plans (Wayfare Pass Student, Monthly and Plus Monthly) space retries 2 calendar days apart with 7 days of grace; the annual plans (Wayfare Pass Annual, Plus Annual and All Access Annual) space them 3 calendar days apart with 14 days of grace.
